lock_semantics: Hard numbering lock written inside the init commit itself (no two-phase unlocked lock). No agent may renumber, move, or repurpose Windows16/. Bumping rules for future windows: never reuse 2/3/4/6/8/9/10/11/12, never gap-fill 1/5/7, never take 13/14/15 (spent/staked by sibling pipelines).
